description: Use to assess how ready an organisation is for NIS2 cybersecurity requirements, or to find its gaps. Call without answers to get the 53 questions in nine domains (governance, risk, incidents, continuity, supply chain, network security, vulnerabilities, training, cryptography), each mapped to NIS2 Arts. 20, 21 or 23. Call with answers (yes, partial, no per question id) to get a score per domain, an overall readiness level and the gaps.

answers.description: Question id to answer, e.g. {"g1": "yes", "r2": "partial"}. Omit to get the questions. Unanswered questions count as gaps.

name: nis2_gap_assessment
title: NIS2 readiness gap assessment
